review_comments: I wonder if the tail call -> loop stuff runs even if the method is marked `NoInlining`?

The algorithm looks for common predecessor sequences so it nees some sort of join point to get started.

There is no successor block for those returns, so no merging happens. I suppose we could treat all the `BBJ_RETURNs` as if they all had a common successor. Shouldn't be too hard to do...
I see. Yeah, this might be a pretty common case where tail merging would kick in.
